{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_with_neg999 = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {len(df_with_neg999)}")

# Check site values
print(f"Unique sites: {df['site'].unique()}")
print(f"Number of unique sites: {df['site'].nunique()}")"}
